# Popcorn

> Popcorn is a modern cinema discovery Progressive Web App (PWA) built with frosted-glass aesthetics, real-time TMDB movie & TV data integration, high-definition trailer playback, circular user score rings, and offline-capable library management.

## Overview
- **App Name**: Popcorn
- **Category**: Entertainment & Video Streaming Discovery
- **Technology**: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion, Service Worker PWA
- **Data Providers**: The Movie Database (TMDB API v3), YouTube Official Embedded Trailers
- **Progressive Web App**: Full PWA support with offline caching, install prompts for mobile & desktop, and standalone display.

## Key Capabilities & Features
- **Featured Cinema Banner**: Dynamic hero billboard showcasing trending blockbusters with one-click trailer modals, quick watchlist toggles, and detailed metadata.
- **Top 10 Ranked Row**: Visual leaderboard of top-charting theatrical releases and trending streaming series with rank numbering.
- **Circular Rating Rings**: Glassmorphic SVG progress rings displaying color-coded TMDB user approval percentages (Emerald for >=70%, Amber for 50-69%, Rose for <50%).
- **Interactive Trailer Modal**: Seamless YouTube player integration for 4K/HD trailers, film synopses, release dates, runtime, genre tags, and cast details.
- **Discover & Genre Filtering**: Granular media filtering across Movies and TV Shows by genre (Action, Sci-Fi, Drama, Comedy, Animation, Horror, Romance, Thriller, Documentary).
- **Instant Search & Suggestions**: Real-time debounce search querying TMDB catalog with fallback curated results.
- **Personal Library & Watchlist**: Local persistence and offline caching of saved movies and series, marked as watched or downloaded.
- **Customizable TMDB API Key**: Built-in settings modal allowing users to enter custom TMDB API keys with instant local storage persistence.

## Main Navigation Endpoints
- `/` or `/?tab=home`: Home feed with featured hero banner, Top 10 leaderboards, trending movies, and popular TV series.
- `/?tab=browse`: Discover catalog with genre pills and media type toggle (Movies, TV).
- `/?tab=search`: Search interface with query input, instant results grid, and quick genre suggestions.
- `/?tab=library`: User's saved watchlist and history with offline playback indicator.
- `/manifest.json`: Web app manifest for PWA installation.
- `/sw.js`: Service worker handling caching and offline resilience.
- `/llms-full.txt`: Full technical documentation and catalog breakdown for LLM agents.
